Guides / Raids, Tower & events / Raids

Raids

Raid parties, passes, damage shares, Raid Eggs, crowns and rewards. Plus the boss now and the next one.

Raid partiesPassesRewardsThe battle

The live list (what is on right now) updates in the live wiki. Open this page in the live wiki to use it.

Raids open with your 5th badge and need the online connection. There's a new 5★ boss every 12 hours: a Mythical from 00:00 UTC, then a Legendary from 12:00 UTC. Each list comes round in turn: all 23 Mythicals every 23 days, all 96 Legendaries every 96 days.

Raid parties

  • You're always in a raid party of 1 to 4. Invite friends; they stay until someone leaves.
  • The boss gets one segment of HP per member with a Raid Pass. Your share grows with your best recent 5★ hits (5,000–50,000; 15,000 before your first).
  • The fight runs in rounds of up to 5 minutes: each member hits once a round (a hit is a 30-turn raid battle with your raid squad). HP carries over, nothing fails. Missing 2 rounds in a row takes you out of the party.
  • You can always earn up to your own share, even if teammates got there first.

Passes

  • 10 free Raid Passes a UTC day. A pass is used only when the boss is defeated, and only by members who did damage.
  • Buy more for 120 Glimmer each (up to 10 a day; kept until used). At most 50 defeats a day.

Rewards

RewardHow
Raid EggsBy your own damage: 1, then one more at 10,000, 20,000, 35,000, 50,000 (5 at most). They hatch the boss at Lv your level cap − 10 (between 20 and 70).
Top damageMost damage (with 2+ members hitting): the crown, +1 Raid Egg and ×1.5 money
Master BallA single hit of 50,000+ damage (1 per fight)
Defeat bonus$5,000, 2 Rare Candy, 13 of the boss's Candy and 6 Bounty Tickets (needs 2,000+ damage)

Raid Eggs roll their looks one by one: Shiny 1 in 40, Void 1 in 120, Prismatic 1 in 300, Gilded 1 in 600, Perfect IVs 1 in 20. Raid Eggs and the Battle Tower are where Gilded Pokémon come from.

The battle

  • The boss is your raid squad's top-3 average level + 6, with ×1.15 stats.
  • Every 6 turns it charges a Big Attack (45% of the active Pokémon's max HP, half on the bench) unless a Support stands; from turn 20 it enrages (+2 Attack and Sp. Atk).
  • Status damage on the boss stops ramping (Toxic caps at 4/16 of a bar). Type matchups, Break + DPS + Support and the Counter button are what score.
  • Raid Hour events add bonus eggs of a species to every raid.
